extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is a Prime Video add-on maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Aurora Cinema is the home and player screen. Website sign-in and the storefront reader use your own account. Includes GPL-3.0-or-later backend code derived from Sandmann79/xbmc. See NOTICE.md for upstream credits. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account. Playback uses this add-on's existing player path and Kodi inputstream. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.15[CR]- Clear runtime credentials in the open interface when sign-out originates from Kodi settings or another invocation.[CR]- Snapshot cached artwork references before notifying active interpreters to purge their account state.[CR]- Includes 0.2.14 first-card focus, TV episode repair, audited sign-out and fresh verified sign-in.[CR]- Preserve all existing playback/card return, Prime sections, preloading and SMOOTH artwork/splash.
